finding.headline: "The Freezer-Stash Mama (Prep Before Baby)"
finding.problem: "My mum can't come for omugwo. Everyone says freeze meals but no one tells me HOW to freeze jollof, pepper soup or moi moi so it still tastes like home."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 31-yr-old Nigerian/diaspora mum in 3rd trimester who wants the omugwo safety net but her mum can't travel; wants to batch-freeze African meals herself.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone / Bundle anchor — "The Diaper-Bag Freezer: 30 African Meals to Freeze Before Baby."". Verdict: PASSES (17/25)..
